coupling: The first commit defines POSIX_MATCH_SLOTS(captures) as captures + 1 and applies it only to preg->re_nsub, where the addition of the whole-match slot is correct. It retains the independent nmatch cap, so that commit is safe by itself. The later validation commit reuses that abstraction on nmatch, although POSIX nmatch already counts the whole-match slot, and replaces both the rc clamp and the unset-entry fill bound with nmatch + 1. Only their composition double-counts the whole match. For an in-contract call with pattern (a), nmatch == 1, and pmatch[1], output_count becomes 2 and regexec writes pmatch[1]. A reviewer must reconcile the slot convention across both commits; changing only one of the two later consumers of the convention still leaves the other successful-match write path beyond the caller's pmatch bound.
